    - img "Close-up of the fuselage panel on Anduril Industries vehicle, featuring the U.S. flag insignia and jet inlet danger warning markings on a bold red and black airframe, representing American-made next-generation autonomous combat aircraft built for the U.S. military."
    - heading "WHO WE ARE" [level=3]
    - paragraph: As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril delivers cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the warfighter in months, not years.
    - paragraph
    - figure:
      - img
    - heading "AUTONOMY FOR EVERY MISSION" [level=2]
    - heading "Our Technology" [level=5]
    - paragraph: Solutions for the software-defined conflicts of today.
    - paragraph: "Today’s conflicts demand software-defined military technology that can be produced at hyper-scale & updated at speed. Unlike traditional defense contractors who focus exclusively on hardware, Anduril’s core product is Lattice: an autonomous sensemaking platform that connects and powers thousands of systems supporting real-world operations."
    - heading "Our Business" [level=5]
    - paragraph: Cutting-edge technology built at speed.
    - paragraph: Anduril is a defense products company. Unlike most defense companies, we don’t wait for our customers to tell us what they need. We identify problems, privately fund our R&D and sell finished products off the shelf. Ideas are turned into deployed capabilities in months, not years, saving the government and taxpayers money along the way.
    - heading "Our Team" [level=5]
    - paragraph: The brightest minds in modern defense.
    - paragraph: Our team brings together the smartest Silicon Valley engineers with veterans who have been on the front lines and have first-hand knowledge of the mission. Anduril engineers are experts in AI, robotics, advanced sensors, secure networking, aerospace, virtual reality technology, aircraft modeling and simulation. Military veterans are more than 12% of our team and use their defense experience to ensure our products meet the needs of the warfighter.
